Text2: Paste your host's room link to broadcast or watch together. The room host runs separately; viewers can also use a browser.
Text11: Choose video and audio below. During a broadcast, your choices are staged; current capture continues until you apply them with a restart.
Text19: System render output — fixed until you select another output
Text20: Application audio captures the selected app and its child processes. System output captures mixed playback from the selected device, including Discord. In-app room sound is muted during system sharing. External browsers and other playback can still be captured; route them to a different output or choose application audio. No microphone is captured. Initialized capture and counters do not prove viewer audibility.
Text21: Allow CPU encoding if hardware initialization fails (may cost game performance)
Text25: Apply briefly stops and restarts capture using your selected video, audio, and output settings with the same stream identity. Requested bitrate is a target; actual network bitrate and viewer playback can differ.
Text30: People in the room can broadcast at the same time. Each person can share one stream and choose which streams to watch.
